page.overview:
What is Acheron?

Acheron was the bridge between the ultimate order of Mechanus and the regimented evil of the Nine Hells. As such, each layer emphasized order primarily, evil secondarily. Acheron was comprised of four layers, each consisting of gigantic floating iron cubes within an infinite airy void. These cubes were illuminated by gray light, resembling moonlight at its brightest.

Though the cubes occasionally collided slowly, no upheaval or tremors occurred, allowing beings to move to a new block if desired.

These blocks reflected the plane's yield to law; almost every block was a perfect cube, and they only rusted or fractured in straight lines and right angles. The cubes were immensely scarred from the unending battles which filled Acheron.

Upon the first layer, Avalas, the dance of the blocks was carefully orchestrated, and creatures of high intelligence could usually discern a pattern for an area by studying the motions. While it was said gravity pulled toward the center of the blocks, in practical terms, gravity acted upon each surface individually. Crossing between faces could be dizzying.
